loginDescription: Manage saves, follow tasks, and inspect your bot.
passwordConfigNote: Administrator credentials are managed in the server configuration.
overviewDescription: A clear view of this instance. Check current activity or start a new save.
capabilityNote: Checks local prerequisites. Availability does not guarantee network or remote service connectivity.
taskScopeNote: Ordinary tasks retain up to 1000 results for about 24 hours. ShardReel saves persist across restarts. Clean terminal upload history is kept for seven days; failed and unfinished tasks remain. Watch forwarding is outside this list.
searchTasks: Search title, task ID, or storage
newDescription: Save files or copy chat history. Closing this page does not cancel an accepted task.
urlsPlaceholder: One Telegram message link per line
storageNote: Capabilities belong to loaded storage instances. They do not prove remote service health. Storage credentials and configuration are not displayed.
fileNote: Read-only browsing of local or ShardReel files. Known local config, session and database files are protected. Manage files in their storage application.
routesNote: Process new media from the source chat continuously. To change a watch, stop it and create a new one.
preferencesNote: Manage save preferences, directory shortcuts and rules here. Directory and rule changes affect future saves without moving or deleting existing files.
startupNote: The console starts after Telegram initialization. For earlier startup failures, inspect the container logs.
configurationNote: Configuration is read-only here. Apply deployment changes by editing the configuration and restarting manually.
auditNote: Up to 100 operations in memory. Cleared on restart. This is not the application's full log.
readOnlyScope: Telegram and personal storage · Explicit operations only
title: Title
copyResultUnit: One message or one album counts as one item.
copyResultMeaning: Execution ended means the forwarding loop finished; check the counts for failed or unattempted items. Unattempted items have not been started. Cancelled or interrupted items are failed attempts in the Bot reply. Success means the forwarding call returned successfully; it does not prove album completeness or a successful source-link edit. Counts are available after execution, not during scanning.
confirmCancel: Cancel this task? Partial saved files may remain. Running tasks can take time to stop.
urlsNote: One link per line. Destination paths are relative to the selected storage.
name: Name
workerNote: Including tasks waiting to finish cancellation
loadedNote: Initialized instances, not remote health checks
sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
login_limited: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait one minute and retry.
csrf_invalid: The request could not be verified. Reload and retry.
task_creation_failed: Task preparation failed. Check the links, task type, destination, and server logs.
task_not_active: This task is no longer active. Refresh the list.
invalid_path: Invalid path. Parent traversal is not allowed.
file_unavailable: The file or directory is unavailable or protected.
internal_error: The operation failed. Check the server logs.
not_found: The requested resource was not found.
forwardHealthNote: Counts one message or album per item. Up to 4 worker slots (including final route checks) and 100 waiting items; the same target chat, across Topics, runs in admission order. Full queues reject new items without replay. Unwatch drops waiting items, not started forwards or accepted local saves. Copy uses a separate queue. Counts reset at restart; success does not prove album completeness or attribution edits. Workers start on demand, and these counters are not a Telegram health probe.
watchHealthNote: Watch counters reset at startup; dropped events are not failed files. Initialized does not mean the network is currently connected.
inputAlbumFallback: Media group lookup failed; only the original message was considered. Album completeness is unverified
inputSelectionNote: Positions refer to submitted links. Selection means inclusion in the task, not download completion or a complete media group. At most the first 100 results are shown.
input_code_duplicate: Already selected by an earlier link
input_code_resolution_failed: Link or chat could not be resolved
input_code_album_unavailable: Media group could not be fetched
scanHealthNote: Completed scan pages since startup. Timeouts and cancellations are failures; durations are per page, not per task. No samples means no scans have completed.
managementNote: Uses the selected user’s Telegram access. Check the result before submitting again.
copyCountNote: Copy 1–5000 recent matching items. An album counts as one item and is forwarded as a group.
previewNote: Synthetic sample only; does not read Telegram or save preferences. Filename templates support literal text and .msgid/.msgtags/.msggen/.msgraw/.msgdate/.origname/.chatid fields here. Actual saving also applies path safety and collision handling.
confirmStopRoute: Stop this route? Waiting watch work will be discarded; already started forwards and accepted saves may finish.
confirmCreateCopy: Copy selected history to the target chat/Topic? This sends Telegram messages.
confirmCreateRoute: Create this watch route? New matching messages will be saved or forwarded.
management_busy: Too many management operations; try later.
management_failed: Operation failed. Check the configured user, Userbot access, chat/Topic, filter and save preferences. Details are recorded in the server log.
management_conflict: The route already exists or this user has a copy task in progress.
copyOutcome_partial: Some selected items failed or were not confirmed
managedTargetNote: Lists creator/admin memberships of the current Userbot account; sending permissions may still be restricted.
keywordPlaceholder:
One keyword per line, e.g.
travel
landscape
excludePlaceholder:
One keyword per line, e.g.
advertising
promotion
keywordNote: Matches message text or captions, not filenames. One literal word or phrase per line, case-insensitive. Blank means no filter. An album is processed if any member satisfies the complete condition; exclusion is per member, not a veto for the whole album.
sampleCaptionPlaceholder: Paste a sample to check the filter; no Telegram messages are read or sent.
chatLoadFailed: Unable to load chats. Loaded results are kept; retry.
noTopics: No topics found; leave the Topic unspecified.
topicLoadFailed: Unable to read local topics. Retry or leave the Topic unspecified.
chooseDifferentTarget: Choose a target different from the source
submissionUnknown: Result unconfirmed. Check the watch list before submitting again.
keywordQuote: English double quotes are not supported in keywords; remove them
filterTooLong: Filter exceeds 256 UTF-8 bytes; shorten the keywords
copySubmissionUnknown: Task creation is unconfirmed. Check the task list before submitting again.
watchMediaNote: Watches photos, videos and files in the selected source; text-only messages are excluded.
noMatchingChats: No matching chats. Adjust the search or refresh the source list.
syncingLists: Syncing from Telegram and saving the list…
chatCacheMissing: No local chat list yet. Use “Refresh list” to sync it.
topicCacheMissing: No local topics yet. Refresh the list or leave the Topic unspecified.
listSyncFailed: Sync failed. Previous list and selection are kept.
list_sync_busy: A list sync is already running. Retry after it finishes.
saveDescription: Paste Telegram message links to save photos, videos and files to the selected storage and directory.
copyDescription: Copy recent messages or albums from one source chat to one destination, with optional Topic and filters.
localStorageMissing: Choose a default storage in Save preferences first.
localRulesNote: Save rules are enabled. Matching files may use the storage or directory defined by a rule.
fileResultMeaning: Counts use files. Unsaved includes failed files and files skipped by the conflict policy; cancellation, interruption and unattempted files are counted separately.
taskSubmissionUnknown: The task may already have been created. Check the task list before submitting again.
confirmDiscardUpload: Discard this task and remove unsaved local copies? Files already saved to the drive are retained. Remote cancellation will be confirmed before cleanup.
upload_connection_failed: ShardReel connection failed. Check the URL, API key and Worker setting.
upload_retry_failed: No complete local file can be retried, or the task was cancelled. Check its details.
directoryEditNote: Relative to the selected storage root. This saves a shortcut without moving files. The physical directory is created when a file is saved.
defaultDirectoryEditNote: This is your default directory. A path change affects future default saves. Changing its storage resets the default directory to the original storage root.
directoryListNote: Add a shortcut, then select it as the default above. Editing or deleting an entry leaves existing files in place.
deleteDirectoryNote: Delete this directory shortcut? Existing files remain. If selected as default, future saves will use the storage root.
deleteRuleNote: Delete this save rule? Existing files remain. Future saves will no longer apply this rule.
savePreferencesFirst: Save your pending preferences above before managing directories or rules.
ruleExpressionNote: Plain text works directly; separate alternatives with |. This field uses regular expressions. Prefix (?i) to ignore letter case.
ruleChosenStorage: Use the storage selected for this save
rulePathExample: For example: Videos; leave empty for the storage root
rulePathNote: Albums automatically receive a caption subdirectory. No folder template is needed. Paths must stay inside the storage root.
ruleEnableNote: Adding a rule does not enable Apply rules. Control that preference above. Changes affect future saves without reorganizing existing files.
rulesEnabledNote: Rules are enabled. Adding, editing or deleting rules affects future saves.
rulesDisabledNote: Rules are disabled. Prepare your rules, then enable and save the preference above.
setting_not_found: The entry no longer exists or belongs to another user. Refresh the list.
invalid_save_path: Enter a valid directory inside storage, without parent traversal, control characters or local drive qualifiers. Shorten long ShardReel paths and remove leading or trailing whitespace from each directory name.
invalid_rule_data: Enter a valid matching expression or select a media form.
save_storage_unavailable: The selected storage is unavailable to this user. Choose another storage.
